verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships an official MCP server (firehydrant-mcp) that would let an AI agent/assistant translate natural-language requests into FireHydrant API actions, and it has slash-commands (`/fh`) in Slack for structured actions, but these are structured commands rather than a documented natural-language command interface, and there's no evidence of a chat-based NL command feature within the product itself. missing for 10: direct product UI/chat support for free-form natural-language commands, evidence of MCP server actually being used for NL-driven actions, independent confirmation of MCP server functioning as intended.
